sn45.21:1.1: Sāvatthinidānaṃ || || Micchatañ ca vo bhikkhave desissāmi sammattañ ca || taṃ suṇātha || || Katamañ ca bhikkhave micchattaṃ || || Seyyathīdaṃ || micchādiṭṭhi || pa || micchāsamādhi || || Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave micchattaṃ || || Katamañca bhikkhave sammattam || || Seyyathīdaṃ || sammādiṭṭhi || pa || sammāsamādhi || || Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sammattan ti || || 1.2.
